name: @genuin/contextual-reels
description: Embeddable contextual reels ad widget for Genuin Inc.

scripts.build: env-cmd -f ../genai/.env.development cross-env NODE_ENV=development vite build --mode development
scripts.prebuild:qa: npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npx tsx scripts/syncVersion.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npm run validate:env && pnpm --filter=@genuin/genai-sdk build:qa
scripts.build:qa: env-cmd -f ../genai/.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa vite build --mode qa
scripts.prebuild:prod: npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx tsx scripts/syncVersion.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run validate:env && pnpm --filter=@genuin/genai-sdk build:prod
scripts.build:prod: env-cmd -f ../genai/.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production vite build --mode production
scripts.publish:oracle:qa: env-cmd -f ./.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npx tsx scripts/uploadToOracle.ts
scripts.publish:oracle:prod: env-cmd -f ./.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx tsx scripts/uploadToOracle.ts
scripts.purge:bunny:qa: env-cmd -f ./.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npx tsx scripts/purgeBunnyStandalone.ts
scripts.purge:bunny:prod: env-cmd -f ./.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx tsx scripts/purgeBunnyStandalone.ts
scripts.deploy:qa: env-cmd -f ./.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npx tsx scripts/npmVersionManager.ts && npm run build:qa && npm run publish:oracle:qa
scripts.deploy:prod: env-cmd -f ./.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx tsx scripts/npmVersionManager.ts && npm run build:prod && npm run publish:oracle:prod
scripts.budget:build: npm run build && npm run budget
scripts.budget:all:build: npm run build && npm run budget:all
